validated_results.title: Association of vitamin D receptor gene polymorphism with protection against prostate cancer and benign prostate hyperplasia.
validated_results.reason: The title indicates a vitamin D receptor gene polymorphism association study, providing a genotype rather than a population-wide vitamin D exposure estimate.

validated_results.title: Molecular characterisation and racial distribution of androgen and vitamin D receptor polymorphisms in patients with prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia and age-matched healthy controls.
validated_results.reason: The study characterises androgen and vitamin D receptor polymorphisms, so the exposure is genetic variation rather than vitamin D intake or status.

validated_results.title: Strategies for chemoprevention of prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review of chemoprevention strategies and trial design rather than an original human study of vitamin D and prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Association between the GCG polymorphism of the selenium dependent GPX1 gene and the risk of young onset prostate cancer.
authors: CRC/BPG UK Familial Prostrate Cancer Collaborators
validated_results.reason: The case-control analysis tests the GPX1 GCG repeat genotype rather than any measured selenium intake or status.

validated_results.title: SELECT: the Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial: rationale and design.
validated_results.reason: The article presents the rationale and design (protocol) of the SELECT trial without reporting original outcome results.

validated_results.title: SELECT: the Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial: rationale and design.
validated_results.reason: This is a trial design and rationale paper for SELECT with no original selenium-prostate cancer incidence results.

validated_results.title: SELECT: the Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial: rationale and design.
validated_results.reason: This is a trial design and rationale paper for SELECT with no original vitamin E-prostate cancer incidence results.

validated_results.title: Serum and tissue lycopene and biomarkers of oxidation in prostate cancer patients: a case control study.
validated_results.reason: Serum and tissue lycopene together with oxidation biomarkers were measured in men already diagnosed with prostate cancer, so exposure does not precede incidence.

validated_results.title: Calcium and cancer.
validated_results.reason: The item is a broad narrative overview of calcium and cancer across multiple sites without original study data.

validated_results.title: Vitamin E succinate inhibits human prostate cancer cell growth via modulating cell cycle regulatory machinery.
validated_results.reason: The work is an in vitro study of LNCaP prostate cancer cell lines treated with selenomethionine and vitamin E succinate.

validated_results.title: Vitamin E succinate inhibits human prostate cancer cell growth via modulating cell cycle regulatory machinery.
validated_results.reason: Vitamin E succinate effects were assessed only in cultured human prostate cancer cells, a preclinical setting with no human incidence outcome.
